pitch_findings.title: A page that ranks on Google returns an error
pitch_findings.seen: https://www.tarrowcreekhvac.example/furnace-tune-up/ returns 404. DataForSEO still ranks it #5 for "furnace tune up tarrow creek" (110 searches a month) and #23 for "furnace tune up cost" (260).
pitch_findings.assumed: The page was removed or renamed without a redirect. Confirm in Search Console once you have access.
pitch_findings.size: 110 monthly searches in the top 20 land on an error page
pitch_findings.first_30_days: Restore the tune-up page or redirect it to the closest live page, then add it back to the menu.

pitch_findings.title: Meta ads are running with no Meta pixel seen
pitch_findings.seen: 7 active ads in the Meta Ad Library, 5 of them linking to the site. A mobile lab load of the home page loaded Google Tag Manager, Google Analytics 4 and the Google Ads tag, but no Meta pixel, and no consent banner.
pitch_findings.assumed: Meta can't see who visits or converts from these ads, so it optimises for clicks. The pixel might fire on another page or only after a click; confirm in Events Manager.
pitch_findings.size: 7 active Meta ads, 5 linking to the site
pitch_findings.first_30_days: Install the Meta pixel through the existing Tag Manager container, with lead events on the quote form and call clicks.

pitch_findings.title: Local searches where the site already ranks 4 to 20
pitch_findings.seen: 10 non-brand keywords rank 4 to 20, led by "hvac tarrow creek" (#9, 480 searches a month) and "ac repair tarrow creek" (#12, 390).
pitch_findings.assumed: Service pages that match each search more closely, and local links, could move these into the top three. DataForSEO estimates; Search Console will show the real positions.
pitch_findings.first_30_days: Rewrite the two pages behind the biggest searches and build service-area pages for the rest.

pitch_findings.title: Fewer Google reviews than nearby rivals
pitch_findings.seen: Tarrow Creek Heating & Air has 88 reviews at 4.7 stars. The three HVAC contractors within 15 km with the most reviews have 311, 198, 157, a median of 198.
pitch_findings.assumed: The rating is strong, so the gap is how often customers are asked, not how they feel. Review dates (pace) come with Business Profile access.
pitch_findings.first_30_days: Add a review request to the job-complete text and invoice, and reply to every review.

pitch_findings.title: No new Meta ad in 75 days
pitch_findings.seen: The newest of 7 active Meta ads started on 2026-08-14. 4 have run 90 days or more, the longest since 2025-12-02.
pitch_findings.assumed: The same people keep seeing the same ads; heating season is the moment to refresh them.
pitch_findings.size: 75 days since the newest ad started; 7 active ads
pitch_findings.first_30_days: Ship a fresh furnace-season set built on the angle of the longest runner.

outreach_email.subject: Your furnace tune-up page is returning an error
outreach_email.body:
Hi [first name],

Searching "furnace tune up tarrow creek" puts your tune-up page at #5 on Google, but https://www.tarrowcreekhvac.example/furnace-tune-up/ returns a 404 error, so anyone who clicks lands on a dead page. That search runs about 110 times a month. Open the link and you'll see it.

We also didn't see a Meta pixel load on your home page while 7 Meta ads are live, so Meta may not know which ads bring calls.

Both are quick fixes before heating season peaks. Worth a 15-minute call this week to walk through the rest?

[Your name]
Example Growth Agency

talk_track.opening: Thanks for the time. We looked only at what anyone can see from outside, so tell us where the outside view is wrong.
questions: Your tune-up page returns an error but still ranks #5 for "furnace tune up tarrow creek". Was it moved on purpose?
We didn't see a Meta pixel on the home page while 7 Meta ads are live. Is it installed somewhere we didn't load, or are the ads judged on calls alone?
You rank 4 to 20 for 10 local searches like "hvac tarrow creek". Which services do you most want more of this winter?
Your rating beats the area, but you have 88 reviews to the leaders' 198. How do you ask customers for reviews today?
Your newest Meta ad is 75 days old. Who makes your ads now, and what has worked best?
access_to_ask_for: Google Business Profile (review dates and reply rate)
Meta Ads and Events Manager (spend, results, pixel)
talk_track.close: With that access we rerun the same audit on your own numbers within a week and send a 90-day plan with the first fixes priced.
